capabilities: Toggle light and dark mode from a status bar icon
Apply themes automatically based on the active note's path
Apply themes based on tags in the active note
Set a default theme when no path or tag rule matches
extras: Support is via email or the author's Discord server; the README lists screenshots but they were not included in the text.
intentEvidence: Path-Specific Themes: Automatically apply specific themes and colors based on the active note's path.
problem: Obsidian only lets you pick one theme and color scheme globally, so different folders or topics can't look different.
summary: Theme switcher that applies themes and light/dark mode automatically based on the active note's path or tags.
